about.heading: Good editing is invisible pacing & emotional tension.
about.subheading: Respecting every millisecond of the viewer's attention.
bio: I am Jashandeep Singh, a video editor and colorist dedicated to turning raw footage into high-retention cinema.

Over the past 7+ years, I've partnered with global directors, flagship brands, and high-growth YouTube creators—driving 120M+ organic views through intentional cuts, rhythmic sound design, and ACES color science.

testimonials.author: Marcus Vogel
testimonials.quote: Jashandeep possesses an uncanny instinct for rhythm. Handing him 14 hours of unstructured footage yielded a launch film that left our executive team silent. Zero fluff, pure impact.

testimonials.quote: Balance is everything in documentary. Jashandeep nails emotional weight without sacrificing momentum. His timeline hygiene and ACES conforms are world-class.

testimonials.quote: Working with Jashandeep boosted our average view duration from 32% to over 54% within two months. He elevates storytelling without cheap gimmicks.
